faqLeft.q: What engine does the Jaguar XE 3.0 V6 S / SC use?
faqLeft.a: The XE 3.0 V6 S / SC uses the AJ126 — a 3.0-litre supercharged V6 petrol engine, fitted from 2015 to 2019/2020 across the X760 generation.

faqLeft.q: How much does a Jaguar XE 3.0 V6 S / SC engine rebuild cost?
faqLeft.a: Rebuilds start from £3,200. Exact price depends on condition and parts required — submit your reg for a fixed-price quote.

faqLeft.q: Which engine code is fitted to my XE 3.0 V6 S / SC?
faqLeft.a: Enter your registration on this page and we'll confirm you have the AJ126 engine before you're quoted anything.

faqLeft.q: Do you rebuild AJ126 XE 3.0 V6 S / SC engines?
faqLeft.a: Yes. We inspect and replace timing chain components, tensioners and guides as standard on every AJ126 rebuild.

faqRight.q: Do you supply used XE 3.0 V6 S / SC engines?
faqRight.a: Yes, in some cases a matched low-mileage used engine is the right option. Our team will advise honestly once we've matched your registration and understood your situation.

faqRight.q: Can you recover my XE 3.0 V6 S / SC if the engine has failed?
faqRight.a: Yes — nationwide recovery is available from £70, and most vehicles are collected within a few hours of booking.

faqRight.q: How long does an XE 3.0 V6 S / SC engine rebuild take?
faqRight.a: Most rebuilds are completed within 3-5 working days from the time your car arrives at our workshop.

faqRight.q: Is rebuilding better than fitting a used engine?
faqRight.a: For most XE 3.0 V6 S / SC owners, yes. A rebuild removes the compatibility risk that comes with an unknown used unit's history, and comes with a 12-month unlimited-mileage warranty — often longer and more comprehensive than what a used engine supplier offers.
